name: Paperwork Brain
summary: Upload a bill, warranty or renewal letter, review the fields AI extracts, and get reminders or answers that cite the original document.
highlights: Event-driven .NET microservices orchestrated with Aspire: upload API, extraction worker, reminders service.
RabbitMQ with the outbox pattern, PostgreSQL, blob storage (Azurite locally).
Claude extraction and cited Q&A, with PostgreSQL and pgvector for document search.

name: PriceScout
summary: Track UK electronics prices, see a product’s price history and set an in-app alert for a target price. The current build uses sample prices.
highlights: Searchable catalog with product deduplication enforced in PostgreSQL.
Repeatable sample imports with one alert per saved target.
React client backed by a typed .NET API and orchestrated with Aspire.
